title: ENS491/2: Systematic Mapping Studies with LLMs
description:
Created a Web App that guides users through creating a Systematic Mapping Study using AI (4-person team).

- Developed a multi-agent MCP system enabling iterative query improvement, paper retrieval and filtering, topic analysis and graphing, then report generation.
- Implemented comprehensive state management for complex workflows.
- User is able to jump in at every step and guide the Agent's behavior.

title: CS408: Drone Data Collection System
description:
Built a sensor-drone-server simulation to exercise network programming (3-person team).

- Implemented GUI dashboards, multi-threading, and socket programming.
- Features statistical anomaly detection and real-time alerts.
- Developed a comprehensive system simulating IoT data collection and processing.

title: CS414: GitHub Developer Centrality and Language Diversity
description:
Analyzed a 50GB graph containing 10 million GitHub users and their repositories (3-person team).

- Carried out community detection powered with cuGraph, Nvidia RAPIDs on Saturn Cloud.
- Discovered that central users in programming language communities usually only know that language.
- Handled large-scale graph data processing and analysis.

title: CS412: IMDB Review Sentiment Prediction
description:
Implemented and compared three sentiment classification models on 50,000 movie reviews (5-person team).

- Compared Logistic Regression with TF-IDF, LSTM, and fine-tuned BERT models.
- Achieved 90% test accuracy and 0.90 macro F1-score using BERT.
- Demonstrated transformer superiority over traditional ML approaches.

title: WitchCraft: Quick CV Tool with AI Enhancement
description:
Quick, drag-and-drop CV creation tool (3-person team, 8-day hackathon project).

- Users only write their info once in the profile.
- Implemented AI to generate CVs tailored to specific job descriptions.
- Designed user-friendly Profile and Home pages with a CV parsing tool.

title: CS310: Real-time Chat Application
description:
Developed a real-time chat mobile app (2-person team).

- Developed the backend using Java and SpringBoot.
- Developed the frontend using React Native.
- Implemented JWT tokens for authentication.
- Ability to sign up, add friends, make groups, and send real-time chat messages.

title: CS308: E-commerce Site
description:
Developed an e-commerce site that sells bags for men (6-person team).

- Used Scrum and Jira to manage the project (played the role of Scrum Master).
- Used GitHub and Git to facilitate collaboration.
- Followed a client-server architectural model.
- Used NodeJS, ExpressJS, and ReactJS.

title: CS306: Database System Using SQL and Firebase
description:
Implemented MySQL and Firebase into CRUD apps (4-person team).

- Designed a relational database system for a computer parts shop.
- Drew an ER-diagram and converted it to SQL.
- Developed triggers and stored procedures.
- Made a simple web interface to interact with the database.
- Developed a real-time support portal for customer requests with Firebase.

title: CS301: Analyzed and Solved the MIS Problem
description:
Studied the Maximum Independent Set problem (2-person team).

- Developed, implemented, and benchmarked a brute force exponential solution.
- Researched, implemented, and benchmarked a heuristic polynomial solution.
- Used statistical methods to ensure robust results.
- Developed a random sample generator and a graph visualizer for testing.

title: Personal Website
description:
Created a personal website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Designed and developed the website to showcase my projects, skills, and achievements.
- Regularly update the site to reflect new projects and skills.

title: PURE: Extracting Merger Deal Initiation with LLMs
description:
As part of the Program for Undergraduate Research, we aimed to produce a database to distill private phase deal metrics using generative AI.

- Collected data via web scraping from the SEC's website.
- Developed methods to filter data and extract relevant sections within documents.
- Tuned Gemini's parameters and engineered prompts.
- Passed documents to the LLM along with the prompts, then collected and validated results.
- Assessed the performance of different prompts and configurations.

title: CS210: Predicting Inflation Using Stock Market Fluctuations in the US
description:
Aimed to study the relation between stocks in a provided stock market database and an inflation database.

- Applied data science principles such as data collection, wrangling, analysis, etc.
- Conducted hypothesis testing and regressive machine learning.
- Analyzed the performance of different machine learning algorithms.

title: CS303: Calculator in Digital
description: Aimed to design and implement an addition calculator circuit in digital using basic logic components like encoders, decoders, multiplexers, flip flops, etc.

title: SUDuyuru: Sabanci University Announcements via Mail Service
description:
Aimed to make keeping up with general university announcements easier by sending the announcements via email.

- Uses Docker Compose for ease of deployment.
- Uses MongoDB to store the announcements.
- Open source on GitHub.

title: Proj201: Measuring Excitement in Sports
description:
Started with the aim of coming up with a quantitative measure of excitement for UFC fights.

- Engineered a solution plan.
- Conducted data collection and wrangling.
- Created a descriptive report of the data to help develop an equation.
- Developed an equation to calculate excitement and made several reasonable conclusions.
